worldcombat.skill.blazekick.summary: Spin up and swing a flame-wreathed leg in a rising arc: pick a foe or just kick a direction up close. The hit lands on the first foe met, dealing contact damage and possibly leaving it burned (burn halves its physical damage and deals damage over time); whether it leaves the ground follows native knockback, so a refused launch keeps the damage and draws no rise. Ignite form burns more often and launches higher; Heavy form kicks harder but leaves fire less often.
The kick sweeps up the rising arc and catches the first foe met for %1$s contact damage, with a reach of %2$s blocks.

On a hit it tries to launch the target %1$s blocks off the ground; whether it leaves the ground follows native knockback, so knockback resistance or a cancelled launch keeps the damage without the rise.

On a hit there is a %1$s chance to leave the target burned: while burning its physical damage is halved and it loses about 6.25%% of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1), lasting %2$s; it also catches fire for 1-3 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.ignite.on: Ignite form: burn chance +12%%, burn duration x1.2 and a higher launch, but kick power x0.88, windup +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.ignite.off: Heavy form: a harder kick on a faster loop; costs fire that is harder to leave and a slightly lower launch.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.growth.0: From level %1$s the kick power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.growth.1: From level %1$s the kick power is %2$s and the burn chance rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.use.0: An upward flaming kick that launches the target
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.use.1: Set a close foe burning to blunt its attacks
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.use.2: Lift a target into the air and break its footing
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.preference.i: On: burn chance +12%%, burn duration x1.2 and a higher launch, but kick power x0.88, windup +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks - for leaving fire behind. Off (Heavy form): a harder kick on a faster loop, but fire is harder to leave and the launch is lower.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in first; the kick reach is short, so a large value often still cannot reach.
When on, a target not already burning ranks higher so a heavy kick is not just a refresh; when off all targets rank alike.
